items.title: The U.S. Didn’t Buy a Drop of Saudi Oil in July — the First Time in 41 Years
items.summary: A 40-year streak just snapped, and it happened fast enough that most investors missed it entirely. The forces reshaping U.S. crude imports in 2026 point to a handful of refiners and one major sitting at the center of a political and commodity storm.
